reason.fa: شروع معمول ۰٫۲ واحد/kg یا حداکثر ۱۰ واحد یک بار در روز، زیرجلدی هر روز در یک ساعت ثابت؛ سپس بر اساس قند خون فردی تنظیم شود.
reason.en: Usual start 0.2 units/kg or up to 10 units once daily, subcutaneously at the same time each day; then individualise to glucose.

reason.fa: دوز فردی، همراه انسولین کوتاه‌اثر؛ بر اساس نیاز متابولیک و پایش قند.
reason.en: Individualised, with short-acting insulin; by metabolic need and glucose monitoring.

text.en: During hypoglycaemia; hypersensitivity to insulin glargine.

text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Published studies with use of insulin glargine during pregnancy have not reported a clear association with insulin glargine and adverse developmental outcomes (see Data ) .

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary There are either no or only limited data on the presence of insulin glargine in human milk, the effects on breastfed infant, or the effects on milk production.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: The safety and effectiveness of LANTUS to improve glycemic control in pediatric patients with diabetes mellitus have been established.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Nevertheless, caution should be exercised when LANTUS is administered to geriatric patients.
